messages:
Vera N: Starting thread for Tenant Beta EU rollout. Customer wants low-latency EU-first and a safe experiment that avoids noisy rollbacks. Propose a chessboard-style canary across AZs + rollforward plan instead of immediate rollback for non-severe regressions. Need owners + short playbook.
Ibrahim K: Interesting. Chessboard = deterministic slice allocation across AZs so we get balanced signal. Proposal: 2% chessboard micro-canary (2h) -> 10% eu-chess (12h) -> 40% eu hold (24h). Shadow NA with 100% logging for 24h.
Dana L: Ops constraints: we need a hard kill-switch that routes to `model-global-stable` in <20s. Also want quarantine bucket routing for requests that hit degraded paths so we can isolate. Who owns that wiring?
Rex T: SRE will own kill-switch and quarantine routing. Suggested triggers: auto-quarantine if 5xx >0.6% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increase >30% vs baseline for 5m. For semantic-quality we do a tiered response: if drift >2% -> rollforward to a widened candidate (model-eu-v1-rollfwd) else if >6% -> full rollback.
Marta S: Product note: customer requires telemetry contract: per-tenant latency histograms, per-route error counts, token-cost delta, and up to 120 sanitized samples/day for first 72h. Delivery cadence: daily for first 4 days then 72h thereafter. Legal must sign DPA for sample sharing.
Legal: We'll need DPA + explicit sample consent. Retention: raw samples 7d max, aggregates 90d. PII stripping required before any webhook.
Ibrahim K: Flag naming suggestion: `beta_tenant.eu.chess.v1`. Console import JSON for canary config (editable):
```
{"flag":"beta_tenant.eu.chess.v1", "canary": [
  {"slice":"chess-2pct","duration":"2h"},
  {"slice":"chess-10pct","duration":"12h"},
  {"slice":"eu-40pct","duration":"24h"}
], "shadow_na": true, "prewarm_mins": 20, "quarantine_target":"model-quarantine-v1", "fallback":"model-global-stable"}
```
Dana L: Ops asks: block all promo campaigns tagged `tenant-beta` during entire canary + 12h. Pre-authorize emergency +40% capacity for first 3h. Also require a manual hold button in Console to pause ramp for up to 6h.
Rex T: Rollforward details: when semantic-quality delta between candidate and baseline is between 2-6% worse, we trigger an immediate rollforward to `model-eu-v1-rollfwd` which is a slightly larger-context variant to recover quality while keeping region routing. This reduces blast radius vs full rollback. If rollforward fails or delta >6% -> standard rollback to `model-global-stable`. Rollforward automation sequence: disable failing slices -> enable rollforward slices -> run fast-eval on sampled 1k prompts -> if pass, continue ramp, else rollback.
Marta S: CS/customer asks for a daily webhook to their staging Slack with: eval delta, latency heatmap (by AZ), 5xx %, and sample count. Also want T+6h and T+24h heatmap artifacts. Can Console do scheduled artifacts + webhooks?
Ibrahim K: Yes, Console supports scheduled artifact uploads + webhooks. Eng-Platform will provide sanitized schema and API key. Key rotation schedule: every 7 days during initial 14d engagement.
Dana L: SRE/Ops test plan: staging rehearsal tomorrow 11:00 UTC: 1) chessboard slice apply 2) kill-switch flip 3) rollforward run 4) webhook delivery. Who volunteers to run each step?@Rex T for kill-switch, @Ibrahim K for flag apply, @Marta S for webhook validation.
Rex T: I'll run the kill-switch test and post logs. Will also validate quarantine routing works by injecting 5xx in staging.
Ibrahim K: I'll stage the flag and the prewarm script. Will output prewarm timings and cache-warm logs.
Marta S: I'll validate webhook payload schema and confirm PII masking. Also coordinate DPA signature with Legal.

Vera N: Final short checklist: Product -> telemetry appendix + customer consent; Eng-Platform -> flag + prewarm + webhook schema; SRE -> kill-switch + quarantine + rollforward automation; Ops -> campaign block calendar + emergency capacity; Legal -> DPA signoff. Please ack by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
